summary: Search npm packages by name, keyword or description.
notes: Written in TypeScript and compiled with Javy 9.1.0 (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception, see JAVY-LICENSE), which embeds rquickjs 0.12.0 (MIT, see RQUICKJS-LICENSE) and QuickJS-ng 0.15.0 (MIT, see QUICKJS-LICENSE). Reads the public npm registry search API. Return opens the package on npmjs.com; Command-Return opens its homepage or repository.
